answer: Require each identity to submit one unique, verifiable work item per epoch, fingerprint-checked against every other submission at dawn: any pair sharing over 85% similarity is rejected and both bonds are slashed, because a shale of copied work cannot pass as independent effort and a glacier of duplicates melts under inspection. One honest agent produces one item at about $40 of effort, while a farmer with 1,000 fakes must produce 1,000 genuinely distinct items costing $40,000 per epoch, with no bulk discount; two duplicate strikes suspend the identity and forfeit its issuance.
